# Qoder provider vendor

Source: [simonsmh/pi-provider-qoder](https://github.com/simonsmh/pi-provider-qoder), version 0.6.12, commit `a8de674d2fdc1f7715ab8d794e51e8e620469ed9`. The upstream [package metadata](https://github.com/simonsmh/pi-provider-qoder/blob/a8de674d2fdc1f7715ab8d794e51e8e620469ed9/package.json) declares MIT; the pinned commit has no standalone license file. Attribution: simonsmh and pi-provider-qoder contributors.

Enso adapts authentication to pi's OAuth storage, isolates identity by request, restricts caches to PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR and integrates the provider with ModelRuntime. Daily-limit node recovery discovers routes within each request, validates regional HTTPS domains and never shares account routing state.
